philosophy: Firebase is an additive branch, not a replacement for stamped JSON seeds or the deep interface contract.
ai_consumption_rules: Read the deep interface and this branch manifest before proposing Firebase changes.
Treat stamped JSON seeds as canonical; Firestore is supplemental unless a future written rule says otherwise.
Do not invent client writes, wallet logic, payment logic, or Solana swaps.
Prefer narrow, additive changes with explicit rules and rollback paths.
Report drift, missing env, and policy mismatches before suggesting implementation.
Keep browser surfaces read-only until a written write path exists.

phases.name: Read-only browser wiring
phases.goal: Expose Firebase config and supplemental reads without writes.

phases.name: Supplemental registry reads
phases.goal: Render Firestore members, rooms, quests, and approved claims as a supplement to the verified seeds.

phases.name: Steward sync
phases.goal: Use the export → dry-run → live sync pipeline from the repo root.

phases.name: Manual claims
phases.goal: Keep `lodge_claims` steward-reviewed and public only when approved.

phases.name: Regulated future branch
phases.goal: Reserve future writes, payments, wallet work, and swaps for a written branch later.

collections.name: lodge_meta
collections.purpose: Supplemental operational metadata for the branch

rules.client_writes: denied until a written write path exists

explicit_non_goals: turn the Hall into an ops console
